data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Yestah', meaning 'God is Righteous'. The name Justelle is used in the Bible to refer to a righteous and just person. It is a strong and inspiring name for a girl with a deep spiritual connection and a strong sense of justice. The name Justelle carries the meaning “Righteous or Just” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Justelle usually hope their child will grow to embody righteous or just and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Justelle total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Τζουστελλ

in_latin.name: Justella
